desc:
Become a vampire, witch, werewolf, or hunter. Explore the world, level up, unlock new abilities, and fight other players.
PLATFORM SUPPORT
💻 PC
📱 Mobile
🎮 Console
PC CONTROLS
SHIFT — Sprint
F — Block / Parry
Q — Dash
SPACE — Jump
E — Interact
Ctrl - Shift Lock
Abilities — Configurable keybinds
Mobile and console controls are adapted for their respective platforms.
NIGHTFALL: ORIGINS is actively being developed.
Expect continued updates, balancing changes, new content, and improvements. Some races, progressions, abilities, and secrets are intentionally left for players to discover.
Inspired by The Vampire Diaries and The Originals and VTM.
Found a bug or have an idea? Let us know in the community.
Best Vampire game to touch the platform
ALPHA RELEASE expect bugs
